# g01 – Constrained optimization problem

## Definition
- **Objective**: Minimize f(x)
- **Variables**: n = 13
- **Domain**: 0 ≤ x_i ≤ 1 for i = 1, ..., 9; 0 ≤ x_i ≤ 100 for i = 10, 11, 12; 0 ≤ x_13 ≤ 1

## Mathematical Formulation

### Objective Function
```math
f(x) = 5 \sum_{i=1}^{4} x_i - 5 \sum_{i=1}^{4} x_i^2 - \sum_{i=5}^{13} x_i
```

### Constraints
```math
g_1(x) = 2 x_1 + 2 x_2 + x_{10} + x_{11} - 10 \leq 0
```
```math
g_2(x) = 2 x_1 + 2 x_3 + x_{10} + x_{12} - 10 \leq 0
```
```math
g_3(x) = 2 x_2 + 2 x_3 + x_{11} + x_{12} - 10 \leq 0
```
```math
g_4(x) = -8 x_1 + x_{10} \leq 0
```
```math
g_5(x) = -8 x_2 + x_{11} \leq 0
```
```math
g_6(x) = -8 x_3 + x_{12} \leq 0
```
```math
g_7(x) = -2 x_4 - x_5 + x_{10} \leq 0
```
```math
g_8(x) = -2 x_6 - x_7 + x_{11} \leq 0
```
```math
g_9(x) = -2 x_8 - x_9 + x_{12} \leq 0
```

## Best Known Value
f(x*) = -15.000000
